newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH SPT SHARES DIVE BUT REBOUND SEEN.
newsitem.headline: CZECH SPT SHARES DIVE BUT REBOUND SEEN.

text.p: Shares in Czech SPT Telecom a.s., the most heavily weighted share on the Prague bourse, plunged on Tuesday led by continued nervousnes about the Czech crown.
Towards the end of continuous trading, SPT was down 180 crowns, 5.6 percent, to 3,005.

"In no way does this reflect company fundamentals...People are waiting to see whether the government can restore confidence in Czech equities (and) whether the central bank is able to support the Czech crown," said Eugene Klerk of ABN AMRO Hoare Govett.

Klerk said SPT, which has fallen in tandem with other major issues such as Komercni Banka and CEZ , was ripe for a rebound adding that the downtrend in Czech major issues made for good opportunities to buy at low prices.
"I really do feel we are reaching the bottom of the correction at the moment," he said.
